Canada and Allies Urge Palestinian Authority to Hold Elections

Canada, along with allies including Australia, the United Kingdom, and France, has urged the Palestinian Authority to hold elections without further delay. These nations also expressed deep regret over the postponement of Palestinian elections. The calls for elections come as international pressure mounts on the Palestinian Authority.
